question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Attract
solution: The correct answer is '**Entice**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Attract**' is '**Entice**'. • **Attract**: to cause somebody/something to go to something or give attention to something. (आकर्षित करना; आकृष्‍ट करना; लुभाना) • *Example: Moths are **attracted** to light.* • **Entice**: to persuade somebody to do something or to go somewhere by offering him/her something nice. (कुछ इनाम या लालच देकर किसी को कुछ करने के लिए मनाना; लुभाना, फुसलाना) • *Example: Advertisements try to **entice** people into buying more things than they need.* **Correct Answer:__** *Entice.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Prevent**: to stop something happening or to stop somebody doing something. (किसी बात को होने न देना या किसी को कोई काम करने से रोक देना) • **Repel**: to send or push somebody/something back or away. (किसी व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु को पीछे या दूर भेज या धकेल देना) • **Disgust**: to cause a strong feeling of not liking or approving of somebody/something. (जुगुप्‍सा उत्‍पन्‍न करना) 3c:T8e5, The erroneous part is** 'Even though Mahindra & Mahindra warn'.**
